_comment: Mapping of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 4 to Rev 5 controls. Schema supports N:M mappings — an r4 control may map to zero (withdrawn), one (renamed / unchanged), or many (split) r5 controls; an r5 control may incorporate from many r4 controls (merged). The page combines two sources: (1) MECHANICAL — auto-derived by R4ToR5Mapper at request time from identity match between the two XML catalogs (catches unchanged numbers, new-in-r5 entries, and withdrawn-from-r4 entries); (2) CURATED — hand-authored entries below. Curated entries override mechanical inferences and supply rationale text. Empty 'curated' is fine — the mechanical layer alone produces a useful diff. To enrich, paste entries from NIST SP 800-53 r5 Annex 4 (the official Rev 4 to Rev 5 mapping); each entry is independent and editing one does not affect others. The schema is forward-compatible: a future r5-to-r6 mapping would mirror this shape with `r5` and `r6` keys.
source_authoritative: NIST SP 800-53 r5 Annex 4 (Rev 4 to Rev 5 mapping)

_kind_values.unchanged: Control number exists in both revisions; substantive content may have evolved.
_kind_values.evolved: Same number; content significantly revised (e.g., expanded enhancements, restructured statements).
_kind_values.withdrawn: Removed in r5 with no direct replacement; r5 field null.
_kind_values.incorporated-into: r4 content moved into one or more r5 controls; r5 field is the destination.
_kind_values.split-into: r4 control split across multiple r5 controls; use multiple curated entries with the same r4 number.
_kind_values.merged-from: r5 control combines content from multiple r4 controls; use multiple curated entries with the same r5 number.
_kind_values.new-in-r5: r5 control with no predecessor in r4; r4 field null.
